title: Cosmic Spiral Sorceress
description: A luminous female figure with closed eyes and crystalline markings on her face and neck holds a glowing spiral galaxy orb between her hands. Her ornate collar and shoulders are adorned with colorful crystals and floral patterns against a swirling cosmic background filled with vibrant energy spirals and floating crystal shards.
prompt: A mystical woman with closed eyes and glowing crystalline patterns on her purple skin, wearing an ornate crystal collar, holds a bright swirling galaxy orb between her hands. Vibrant pink, blue, and green energy spirals and floating crystal shards surround her against a dark cosmic background, intricate fantasy digital painting with luminous details and rich color contrast.
